items.title: Walmart CFO: ‘Value and speed’ is the winning combo amid $4 Gas
items.summary: Walmart (WMT) CFO John David Rainey joins Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi and Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma to discuss the company's latest earnings report, crediting value, faster delivery, and early holiday sales running ahead of last year.

items.title: Is Target finally catching up to Walmart?
items.summary: Walmart (WMT) posted third quarter earnings results that beat Wall Street's expectations. Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi shares a few of his thoughts on the print, especially compared with Target's (TGT) recent results.

items.title: WMT Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, Strong Digital Sales Lift Outlook
items.summary: Walmart beats Q3 earnings and revenue estimates as e-commerce, advertising and membership growth drive results, prompting higher fiscal 2027 guidance.
